title: Unhandled panic in tokio::spawn SSE coalescing task
description:
What: events.rs lines 230-316 spawn a background task that owns the broadcast receiver and drives the SSE stream. The task has no panic handler. If a panic occurs during coalescing (e.g., during serde_json serialization, or an unwrap), the task silently dies without logging an ERROR-level message. The SSE stream hangs — the client receives no data and no connection reset.

Why: Tokio's task panic handling depends on runtime configuration. A solo maintainer may not realize that task panics are not automatically surfaced. Future refactorings (e.g., adding new field validation or unwrap on a lookup) could introduce panics. No integration test exercises the panic path.

How to apply: Wrap the coalescing loop in a catch_unwind or explicit panic=abort handler. Log panics at ERROR level with full context. Add an integration test that triggers a panic (e.g., by injecting a malformed StateChange) and verifies the connection closes cleanly instead of hanging.
